summary: Iteration 3 regression verification after removing ajv/ajv-keywords from yarn 'resolutions' (kept in npm 'overrides'). Backend: 7/7 pytest regression tests pass. Frontend: login screen renders correctly with Bet Tracker Pro branding at preview URL (HTTP 200), admin login (admin@bettracker.pro/admin123) succeeds and redirects to dashboard (Vezérlőpult). All 5 post-login API calls (auth/login, settings, bankrolls, analytics, limits/status) return 200. No console errors, no page errors, no blank screen, no 502.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix confirmed working. Frontend dev server serves login page; admin login redirects to dashboard with all API calls 200. Package.json split of resolutions vs overrides is stable. No known regressions.
rca of the issue: Iteration 2 issue root cause was yarn 'resolutions' forcing ajv v8 which broke craco/ajv-keywords (Unknown keyword formatMinimum). Fix (main agent iter 3): moved ajv/ajv-keywords out of 'resolutions' and kept only in npm 'overrides' block so yarn/craco uses compatible versions locally while Vercel npm build still gets the override. Verified: dev server up, login works end-to-end.
